albums.title: Parachutes
albums.description: The debut album that introduced the band to the world and won a Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album.

albums.title: A Rush of Blood to the Head
albums.description: A piano-driven second album that won the band another Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album.

albums.title: X&Y
albums.description: A huge third album that hit number one in many countries and cemented the band as stadium headliners.

albums.title: Viva la Vida or Death and All His Friends
albums.description: Produced with Brian Eno, this album's title song became the band's first US number one single.

albums.title: Mylo Xyloto
albums.description: A bright, colorful concept album that includes a duet with Rihanna.

albums.title: Ghost Stories
albums.description: A quieter and more emotional album than the ones before it.
